title: CLOSINGBALANCEYEAR with the year end "6/30" as its third argument evaluates on June 30

source.quote: If you do not use Filter, you can write YearEndDate as the third argument.
source.supports: the year end as third argument

source.quote: YearEndDate is a text literal with a date, for example “06-30”.

derivation: With the year ending June 30, the year that contains 2023-02-15 ends on 2023-06-30; sales on that date are 60 (December 31, 2023 has 80).
